summary.intent: Implement PR 5 in a stacked series for the callisto-graph release tooling: narrow dependency publish edges in release derivation by ecosystem, with a test, and update the related spec (REL-ORD-02).
summary.outcome: Fixed publish-edge derivation in derive.rs to narrow dependency edges by ecosystem, added a test (verified by a mutation check, with all derive tests and snapshots run), updated REL-ORD-02 in docs/specs/release.json, added a changeset, ran CI, then committed, pushed, extended the stack and set the PR title and body.

repo: Release derivation lives in crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release/derive.rs; publish-ordering requirements are tracked in docs/specs/release.json (e.g. REL-ORD-02) and should be updated alongside behavior changes.
The repo uses stacked PRs (this was PR 5 on its own branch) and changesets for user-visible changes.
Derive tests include snapshot tests, and existing dual-owner and npm workspace fixtures plus a repo helper can be reused for new derive tests.
ReleasePackageId has accessors used when computing publish prerequisites (link_publish_prerequisites).

code.finding: link_publish_prerequisites previously created dependency publish edges without regard to ecosystem; the fix restricts edges so they only connect packages of the same/relevant ecosystem.
REL-ORD-02 spec entry was updated to reflect the ecosystem-narrowed publish edge behavior.

workflow: Ran a mutation check (revert/break the fix to confirm the new test fails) before trusting the test.
Ran the full derive test suite including snapshots after the change to catch unintended snapshot drift.
Ran CI locally before committing and pushing the PR.
